name: Uploads Artifact
description: A workflow run uploaded this artifact — GitHub's own attribution (`workflow_run.id` on the artifact), not a derivation. The vocabulary corpus sources this edge on the DECLARED job (`workflow_job`, from `actions/upload-artifact` steps); this is the EXECUTION side, sourced on the run, because that is what the artifact listing records. The declared side is still open (see the article).

head_branch.description: The ref the producing run was on. The trust-boundary question: an artifact uploaded from a fork's pull request and downloaded by a privileged workflow is the ArtiPACKED shape.

head_sha.description: The commit the producing run built.
